name: Payment Method 3 Code
definition: Specifies the transfer method that will be used to transfer an amount of money.

CHK.name: Cheque
CHK.definition: Written order to a bank to pay a certain amount of money from one person to another person.

TRF.name: Credit Transfer
TRF.definition: Transfer of an amount of money in the books of the account servicer.

TRA.name: Transfer Advice
TRA.definition: Transfer of an amount of money in the books of the account servicer. An advice should be sent back to the account owner.
